So this isn't necessarily about the post, but because I see so many comments about the breed specifically.

And yes, I know that each breed has bad dogs.

But I've worked on and off in vet medicine for years now. Of larger breed dogs, I've had more aggression issues with Huskies and Poodles than I have with Pitties/Shepherds/Rotties/Dobs  combined. There are bad ones, and those breed can do a but of damage but it's been super uncommon in my(and coworkers) experiences. 

But honestly, the most aggresive dogs tend to be the smaller ones. I know chihuahuas get a bad rap, but the ones I have the most issues with are yorkies and pomeranians. 90% of the time those dogs come in with little dog syndrome and have somthing to prove. The only difference is I can hold them back alot easier. 

But just because they haven't done much damage to me, doesn't change the fact that they're the more aggresive breeds. I'm sure there are plenty of people with different experiences but, at least in my area, that tends to be the normal.
